judge.text: No LLM judge: BFCL is scored by its abstract-syntax-tree checker and BigCodeBench by its unit tests (the registry's per-item acc); each new failure is classed by deterministic rules over the stored response, the parsed tool calls, the extracted program and the test output.

provenance.what: Counts of new failures by class for every BFCL and BigCodeBench run the capability figures draw (Figure 6 and the all-model capability figure), with the error analysis's item-bootstrap intervals for each pool.
provenance.source: the BFCL and BigCodeBench error analysis's work directory, outside the repository (its class tables hold response text); every path below is relative to it

bootstrap.kind: item-cluster multinomial resample over items (every run of a pool moves together on an item), percentile 95% intervals; seed-to-seed variance is not in them

provenance.new_failure: an item the run's seed-matched unsteered run (anchor_run_id) answered correctly and the run did not; a gain is the reverse. A pool sums its runs' counts.

classes.name: no_call_other
classes.definition: no tool call: an answer in prose, a clarifying question or a claim of no access

classes.name: no_call_declination
classes.definition: no tool call, with explicit declination wording (keyword rule)

classes.name: malformed_call
classes.definition: an attempted call the parser could not extract intact

classes.name: call_then_cap
classes.definition: a parsed call followed by text that ran to the 1,024-token cap

classes.name: wrong_call
classes.definition: an intact call with the wrong function, arguments or number of calls

classes.name: irrelevance_call
classes.definition: a call on an irrelevance item, where the correct answer is to call nothing

extras.name: no_call
extras.definition: no tool call at all (no_call_other + no_call_declination)

extras.name: declination_narrow
extras.definition: no tool call and the narrower declination rule (the refute verifier's regexes)

extras.name: truncated_loop
extras.definition: reached the cap in a loop repeating a passage

classes.name: no_code_prose
classes.definition: format: prose and no code, not a refusal

classes.name: refusal_or_objection
classes.definition: a refusal of or objection to the task (keyword rule over the text before the code)

classes.name: malformed_code
classes.definition: format: a malformed or mis-extracted program

classes.name: cap_no_program
classes.definition: format: ran to the 4,096-token cap with no complete program

classes.name: wrong_code
classes.definition: wrong code: a logic, API or syntax error in the extracted program

classes.name: undecidable
classes.definition: the answer fails only a self-test it appended itself

extras.name: refusal_safety
extras.definition: an outright refusal on safety grounds

extras.name: objection_extraction
extras.definition: an objection that left no extractable program

extras.name: objection_code
extras.definition: code that fails after a preamble disputing the specification

extras.name: header_omitted
extras.definition: format: a bare function without the imports the task header supplies
